evidence: Adds functional test coverage for outbound connection management, including stale-tip extra connections, block-relay-only peer rotation, and network diversification.
rationale: Adds end-to-end test coverage for core P2P outbound connection management heuristics that were previously difficult to test. As noted in the description, it tests autonomous connection decisions merged across past PRs (#11560, #19858, #27213) without altering node logic.
